NOTE
**Still not ready — fix-up commits need squashing**

New: The author pushed three commits fixing the icon alignment laurynmm asked about (vertical alignment, spacing, and a 1px nudge) and updated the screenshots. Missing: the formatting and 1px-nudge commits should be squashed into the commits they belong to, and several self-review checklist items are still unchecked (e.g. responsiveness, corner cases).

###### Next step

Keep "not ready"; once the commits are cleaned up, laurynmm can confirm the alignment in the new screenshots and hand it off for "maintainer review".

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for fixing the alignment! Please squash the "Fix formatting via prettier" and "Nudge icon alignment by 1px" commits into the commits they belong to (see our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)), and finish the unchecked self-review items. Then @laurynmm can take another look.
```
